purpose: One analytic clip-corner fixture, followed only on proof success by the predeclared DDWMR single query. This is not the future matched 15-second profile.
memory_enforcement: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no IVP may launch until a process-level 1024 MiB limit is verified
rational_precision: exact reduced rationals, capped at 32768 bits per numerator/denominator/intermediate

transcendental_profile.range_reduction: none; rational Taylor remainder is valid globally; broad results terminate UNKNOWN

retry_semantics: No cap or precision increase. A rejected step or inclusion failure is counted; only predeclared interval subdivision may continue, with the same action and full fixed-label image.
stopping_semantics: On any cap, unsupported arithmetic, failed full-slab inclusion, invalid interval domain, or timeout: preserve diagnostics, emit no proof-complete tube, and stop this profile's result series.
selection_and_order: run the one DDWMR query only after a proof-complete analytic fixture
do not substitute or reorder either case after observing an outcome
